name: Narmada University Library
description: An ancient, grand academic center built on the cliffs of the Narmada River, blending 19th-century Victorian Kolkata aesthetics with ancient Hindu motifs.
notes: Constructed 10,000 years ago under the first Naga King to map Jambhudweepa. It features cream and brick-red walls, tall green-shuttered windows, teakwood desks, and shelves overflowing with ancient palm-leaf manuscripts and leather-bound tomes. Subtle steampunk steam pipes hum softly along its walls, and it serves as the intellectual battleground between Professor Onko and Digha Jani.
sources: Digha Jani and the Cosmic Secrets of Jambhudweepa
The Predatory Sentience of Asura Planets
